<ic>To develop the mana crystal capacity of Morrow.<br>The creation of a Sinecure: The Phoenix Caverns, a mana crystal facility in Morrow, Urizen.<br>
The owner of the Sinecure, the Augur of the Phoenix Caverns, whose duties will be to manage the caverns, will be appointed by Urizen Senators in unanimity, falling back to a greater majority nomination by the senate. <br><br>Proposed by Morrow, seconded by Karov.</ic>

===Overview===
* To create a [[sinecure]] providing a bounty of [[Game_items#Mana_Crystals|crystal mana]].
* Defeated

===Cost===
* 10 wains of mithril

===Date===
* Spring Equinox 378YE
